usage: Run lattice validate after a fresh PASS or after entering TEST; unchanged material returns a reused PASS with zero command executions.
expectedOutcome: A real REVIEW-to-TEST transition and immediate validate complete successfully without canonical metadata dirt or a redundant full validation run.
actualTranscript: The formal 46-command validation passed, REVIEW-to-TEST skipped rerunning validation as a trusted metadata descendant, and the immediate live validate returned status pass, disposition reused, commandExecutions=0 in 5.6 seconds.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual behavior match: lifecycle writes converged cleanly and the repeated validation executed zero configured commands.
limitations: The existing validation suite has a separate memory-isolation issue on this machine: a 1–2 GB inherited Node heap cap OOMs the vocabulary guard, while default heap can swap; 3 GB is stable. This is outside the causal metadata reuse scope and should be a follow-up story.
pitfalls: Keep validation identity environment stable between the full PASS and reuse attempt; changing NODE_OPTIONS changes the identity digest and correctly refuses reuse.
